note: Scenario fixtures for the product decisions of 7 November 2026. Each vector gives a state, one command and the required outcome. 'effects: NONE' means no journal, voucher, voucher-counter, posting_sequence, case-balance or snapshot change. Names such as EARLIER_PERIOD_OPEN are fixture labels, not an API contract. Status DECIDED = the rule is in S; PROPOSED = awaiting approval and must not be implemented yet; DRAFT_EC = follows the draft engineering contract (engineering-contracts-draft-2026-11-07.md), not yet approved by the implementation designer, so the vector may change when the EC is approved. A 'concurrent' command list means the commands run at the same time and 'outcomes' describes the set of results.
